01 / THE PRINCIPALIDENTITY OUTLIVES IMPLEMENTATION

THE GOVERNING PRINCIPLE

The principal persists.
The components may change.

A model is not the identity of a persistent system. Sessions, processes, credentials, runtimes, and hosts may serve a principal without defining it.

Understand the distinction ↗

03 / THE IMPLEMENTATIONCONTINUUM / VERA

FROM REFERENCE TO RUNTIME

An environment
that remembers who acts.

Continuum is Asentxia’s flagship implementation of DCA: a persistent machine-native runtime substrate for autonomous principals.

At its center is VERA — Verifiable Entity with Revocable Authority. A Continuum Computer is a persistent logical computing resource distinct from any one process, host, model, or session.

Enter Continuum ↗
